error_taxonomy.definition: A returned candidate is labeled as an invalid relation or irrelevant link.
A result omits or changes the task/system/deployment scope needed for interpretation.
A result changes claim type, overstates status, or lacks required evidence discipline.
The method abstains on an eligible observation; abstention is retained as its own dimension.
A supplied counterexample or negative-knowledge target is not surfaced when eligible.
Explicit reviewer labels disagree for the same observation.

non_claims: No run, reviewer label, model output, interval, or statistical power is asserted.
Separate dimensions are retained; no aggregate quality score is computed.
Protocol capacity and task repetition are not empirical replication.

outcome.reason: No repeated run, reviewer, or LLM observations were supplied.

protocol_capacity.reason: Authored MTH-0174 capacity is copied from its immutable protocol digest; no observations are included.

purpose: Deterministic aggregation and error-analysis hooks for MTH-0174 and MTH-0172.

small_sample_policy.warning: A warning is emitted when a measured denominator is below the threshold; observations are not discarded.
